description: Default capability for the main window. Core, the opener plugin, the printing commands registered through invoke_handler, and exactly two window permissions - nothing else. `core:default` deliberately excludes window SETTERS, which is why the Full Screen button silently did nothing in the packaged build: `setFullscreen` was denied and the catch swallowed it. The two grants below are the narrow fix - fullscreen state read and write for the kiosk toggle. Still no shell, no filesystem, no HTTP, no process, and no other window mutation.
